verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents a local-first workflow: develop and iterate locally, then move to the cloud. It also offers a local MCP server for local DuckDB databases, so an agent can work against local data instead of cloud production databases. Read-only MCP restriction and per-agent compute isolation exist, but they limit writes or isolate compute rather than provide a separate test dataset. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or staging environment, database cloning or branching for test copies, documented separation of test and production data for agents, and independent corroboration.
